content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application process for Goa Shipyard Limited Recruitment 2026 begins on 28 October 2026 at midnight and closes on 27 November 2026 at 5:00 PM. Candidates must submit the form and pay the applicable application fee within the prescribed application window.

content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Goa Shipyard Limited has announced 91 vacancies in 20 Non-Executive post categories. Technical Assistant (Mechanical) has the highest number of vacancies with 15 posts, followed by Technical Assistant (Electrical/Electronics) with 12 posts and Technical Assistant (Shipbuilding) with 10 posts. The notified vacancies include backlog reserved vacancies. The number of posts may be increased or reduced at the discretion of GSL management. content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Goa Shipyard Limited Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 must possess the prescribed educational qualification and relevant work experience for their chosen post. Eligibility varies across engineering, technical, nursing, safety and other positions. For Technical Assistant positions, a Diploma in the relevant engineering discipline is compulsory. Candidates possessing only B.E. or B.Tech qualifications without the required Diploma will not be considered eligible. The notification also specifies acceptable grouped engineering disciplines for certain posts.

content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly remuneration according to the post and year of service. The first-year salary ranges from Rs. 27,200 to Rs. 41,400 per month. Different consolidated pay amounts are prescribed for the second and third years. Applicable statutory deductions such as Provident Fund, ESI and Income Tax will be made from consolidated pay. Medical benefits, canteen facilities, welfare facilities and Group Personal Accident Insurance may be provided as per GSL rules.

content_sections.heading: Goa Shipyard Limited Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for Goa Shipyard Limited Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 consists of a Written Test, Document Verification and Skill/Trade Test. The written examination may be conducted through Computer Based Test (CBT) or Pen and Paper Based Test (PBT). The written examination will normally contain 25% General Aptitude questions and 75% questions related to the relevant subject or trade. The selection weightage differs according to the post category. The minimum qualifying standards apply to the Written Test and Skill Test as specified in the notification. Eligible internal fixed-term employees and advance trainees may receive skill-test weightage under GSL rules.

Applications through offline or other modes will not be accepted. Visit the official website at www.goashipyard.in . Open Notice Board and navigate to Careers. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) for filling up various Non-Executive positions on a fixed-term contract basis across their operational departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under GSL Advt No 09/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 91 vacancies have been notified for various Non-Executive posts including Technical Assistants, Junior Supervisors, Fitters, Welders, Nurses, and Cooks.

faq.question: Q3. What are the start and end dates for online application?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications starting from 28 October 2026. The last date to complete and submit the online application form is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Technical Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum 03 years full-time Diploma in the relevant engineering branch (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Shipbuilding, Instrumentation, or Civil) from a recognized institute or university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to GSL Non-Executive posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is generally 33 years for most posts, 36 years for Assistant Superintendent (Hindi Translator), and 41 years for Steward cum Cook, as on 30 September 2026. Age relaxations apply for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for GSL recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, General, OBC, and EWS candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 200/- online. SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these contract posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay ranges from Rs. 27,200 to Rs. 45,700 depending upon the specific post and grade structure allocated under the fixed term contract terms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for GSL recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a Written Test (which may be conducted as a Computer-Based Test or Pen-Paper Based Test), followed by Document Verification and a Skill/Trade Test.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with B.E. or B.Tech degrees apply for Technical Assistant posts?
faq.answer: No, candidates who have done B.E. or B.Tech and do not possess the required Diploma qualification will not be considered eligible for Technical Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for GSL Non-Executive Posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official website www.goashipyard.in by navigating to the Careers section, filling out the required details, uploading necessary documents, and paying the fee.
